name: comp-278
blurb: Bordered error alert with bulleted list of issues.
description: Bordered error alert displaying multiple validation errors in a bulleted list format. Provides visual prominence for showing all form errors together.
use_when: Form-level validation feedback with multiple failures. When borders aid visual grouping.
avoid_when: Single errors or minimal styling preference. Dense layouts.
a11y: List provides semantic structure. No ARIA alert role; parent should add role='alert' and aria-live='polite'.
